heading.title: Hearing of the suit and examination of witnesses

article.title: Power to get statements recorded on commission.
article.content:
19Power to get statements recorded on commission.

Order 18, Rule 19
Notwithstanding anything contained in these rules, the court may, instead of examining witnesses in open court, direct their statements to be recorded on commission under rule 4A of Order XXVI.]

1 Ins. by Act 46 of 1999, s. 27 (w.e.f. 1-7-2002).
